The '''Big Blind''' is the second [[Blind]] of each ante. It can be [[skip]]ped to receive a [[Tag]]. The Big Blind has a base chip requirement multiplier of X1.5. Defeating the Big Blind will always reward {{Money|4}} upon defeating it, unless Blind payouts have been disabled by one of the two [[Challenge Decks]] (which are {{D|The Omelette}} and {{D|Cruelty}}).

==Score Requirements==
{{Blind Score|multiplier=1.5}}

==Trivia==
===In other media===
*The Big Blind makes an [https://survivors.wiki/w/Big_Blind appearance] as a [https://survivors.wiki/boss boss enemy] in ''[[wikipedia:Vampire Survivors|Vampire Survivors]]''.
